policy: The survey record seeds the mechanic only. All geometry, rendering, procedural generation, browser interaction, and grading are original. No NASA or third-party artwork is redistributed.

sources.used_for: Three ground-station complexes, spacecraft communication requests, dish aiming, Earth rotation, and handoff when a spacecraft sets over a station horizon.

original_transformation: A procedural orthographic 3D globe with explicit line-of-sight replay, visible station/spacecraft depth cues, persistent transfer progress, and two input surfaces.
